steps.title: Rear seal ring A stretched over the core into the rear groove
Front seal ring B stretched over the core into the front groove
Printed nose disc glued on the plunger front face
M1.6 nut dropped into the carriage hex pocket
Steel tongue shim glued into the carriage pocket
Thrust sleeve into gear B (carriage side)
Plunger (core + rings + nose) pushed into the reservoir from the open dry end
End cap spigot pressed into the reservoir port
Fill septum plug pressed into the cap side bore
Duckbill valve dropped into the open cap slot and pressed into its pocket
Valve plug pressed into the slot (flush with the cap top)
Dry bush pressed into the dry-end bearing bore
Far bush pressed into the wet-end bearing bore
Reservoir sub-assembly (reservoir, plunger, cap, septum, valve) lowered into the shell
Carriage sub-assembly lowered onto the rail, then slid -Y so the shim enters the plunger socket
notes: first collision at s = 6.00 mm before the CAD position with bottom

steps.title: Gear B + sleeve lowered into the gear plane
notes: first collision at s = 3.10 mm before the CAD position with bottom

steps.title: Leadscrew inserted from the dock end through far bush, nut, sleeve, dry bush
notes: first collision at s = 28.00 mm before the CAD position with bottom

steps.title: Motor (gearbox, shaft, boss, terminal block, pins) laid into the three cradles
Gear A slid onto the motor D-shaft from the dry end
notes: first collision at s = 2.00 mm before the CAD position with bottom

steps.title: Thrust collar slid on the rod end
Spindle magnet glued on the rod end face
Needle + hub pressed into the cap guard tube from the dock mouth
Pod sensor board lowered onto posts and locating pins
FFC cable pushed into the ZIF connector (flip lock) from the +X side
Gasket laid on the bottom tongue
Lid lowered straight down (FFC cable through its slot)
Dock insert slid into the dock window from the +X mouth until the detents click
notes: first collision at s = 16.70 mm before the CAD position with bottom

steps.title: Dock magnet d2x1 glued into the rear lug pocket of the dummy head
notes: first collision at s = 1.60 mm before the CAD position with cannula_adapter

steps.title: Dock: dummy head pushed into the pod mouth, snap arms spread and latch behind the dome
notes: first collision at s = 13.70 mm before the CAD position with bottom
